videos.title: Getting the apps
videos.blurb: Where to find Mingla and Mingla Host, and which one you need.

videos.title: Sign up and create your brand
videos.blurb: Your account, then the brand people actually see — name, contact, cover and colours.

videos.title: Connect a bank and get paid
videos.blurb: Stripe for most countries, Paystack for Nigeria — and why your address, not a menu, picks the rail.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a one-night event
videos.blurb: A one-night event from start to finish: the seven steps, a ticket priced in dollars, and the live page it ends on.

videos.title: Sell tickets to an event in Nigeria
videos.blurb: The same seven steps on a Nigerian brand — a Lagos timezone, a ticket priced in naira, and Paystack underneath.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a multi-day event
videos.blurb: Three dates on one event page, priced per day, so a guest buys a pass for each day they choose.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a multi-day event in Nigeria
videos.blurb: A two-night weekend in Lagos on one page — a Lagos timezone, per-day passes in naira, and guests picking their days.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a weekly event
videos.blurb: An event that happens every week: choose Recurring, set a weekly pattern, and decide when the run ends.

videos.title: Sell tickets to an online event
videos.blurb: A ticketed stream: the format set to Online, a link instead of an address, and an unlimited pass sold online only.

videos.title: Sell tickets to an online event from Nigeria
videos.blurb: A live-streamed event on a Nigerian brand — Lagos time, a stream link, and a pass priced in naira and sold online only.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a hybrid event in Nigeria
videos.blurb: One event with two ways in — a public address and a private stream link, a capped room tier and an uncapped stream pass.

videos.title: Sell tickets to a hybrid event in New York
videos.blurb: The same hybrid event on a US brand and Stripe — an address the public sees, a stream link only ticket holders get, and two tickets that behave differently.

videos.title: Run a free RSVP night
videos.blurb: No tickets, just a list — cap the numbers, let guests bring extras, approve people automatically or one at a time, and take an optional chip-in.

videos.title: Create an unlisted RSVP event in Nigeria
videos.blurb: An invite-style RSVP night in Lagos: cap the room, approve every guest, hide the public details and share an Unlisted link.

videos.title: Create a recurring event in Nigeria
videos.blurb: A weekly Lagos event with eight Sunday dates, a ₦100 Rooftop Pass, Paystack payouts and a street address that stays private until purchase.

videos.title: Create and submit your venue
videos.blurb: Create a complete Brooklyn venue listing with saved hours, six photos, a true video cover, public details and reservations, then submit it to Mingla for review.

videos.title: Polish your listing and go live
videos.blurb: Polish a venue listing while it is in review, correct its hours, check the video cover, gallery and public details, save honest venue-fit answers, then verify the approved Live on Mingla page.

videos.title: Build your menu
videos.blurb: Build a venue menu in Mingla Host: categories, dishes with a guest price and a private cost, choices, a service window and a cheaper smaller portion, then reorder, 86 a dish and check the public menu.

videos.title: Build your guest list and groups
videos.blurb: Build your guest list in Mingla Host: add a person by hand, import a CSV after checking the preview, gather people into a group, then start an email or SMS campaign to that group.

videos.title: Send a campaign to a group
videos.blurb: Send an email campaign to a group in Mingla Host: pick the audience, write and format the email, add an event card and a link, send it after the review, then open the sent campaign to see how it did.
